# Chart Checklist

> A chart and data visualisation quality checklist for humans and AI agents. Rules cover honesty, encoding, colour, accessibility, layout, states, narrative, interaction and 3D, maps, and process.

## Core files

- README.md: overview and the full checklist
- rules/rules.json: the machine-readable rule corpus with sources
- rules/data/: the source of truth for each category
- skills/chart-checklist/SKILL.md: the agent review workflow
- checklists/agent-review.md: the short agent loop and report shape
- docs/checks.md: what each check mechanism can prove
- docs/relationship-map.md: the controlled relationship list used by E1
- docs/conflicts.md: source disagreements and the rule choice
- docs/frontend-handoff.md: which repo owns a finding
- docs/other-checklists.md: related checklists and sources
- docs/chartability-map.md: the Chartability mapping

## Use

Run `node scripts/query-rules.mjs --tier critical --json` for the blocking rules. Record pass, fail, or n/a for every rule. A blank result is a failure. Hand page-level issues to the Front-End Checklist.
